name: Urugi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Urugi village emblem in green: a disc with a pointed top bearing white strokes, like a stylised tree.
history: Municipal flag of Urugi, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 December 1979.

features.role: Urugi village emblem — a disc with a pointed top bearing white strokes, like a stylised tree
